cell2_inner_involutions.conclusion: no inner involution can reduce rank -- form-independent (algebra level)

cell3_outer_route.conclusion: tau exchanges the fundamental weights of the 27 and 27-bar, so on Fix(tau) they are ISOMORPHIC: the 27 restricts SELF-DUAL. Self-duality is inherited by restriction to ANY subalgebra, so the entire outer route -- F4, C4 and every subalgebra of either -- makes the 27 REAL

torality_step.theorem: Steinberg: in a SIMPLY CONNECTED group the centralizer of a semisimple element is connected
torality_step.argument: for commuting involutions x,y: Z(x) is connected, x lies in its centre hence in every maximal torus of Z(x), and y semisimple lies in some maximal torus T of Z(x); so <x,y> is inside T -- TORAL, centralizer contains a torus, rank 6
torality_step.why: Z(x) need not be simply connected (this is why E8 has non-toral 2^5)

verdict.scope: the simply connected form of E6
routes_closed: the entire OUTER route (rank 4 but the 27 goes REAL, form-independent)
the surviving hatch A4/D5/S5 (elementary abelian rank <= 2 => toral in the simply connected form => rank 6)
verdict.hatch_NOT_closed: a rank-2 elementary abelian subgroup that is NON-TORAL in the ADJOINT form E6/Z3
